description: Parameters of 3-states salient-pole synchronous machine with quadratic/exponential saturation: IEEE Std 1110 §5.3.1 (Model 2.1). GENSAL or GENSAE model in PSSE and PSLF

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component

Td0_p.description: Time constant of transient d-axis voltage Units: s.

Td0_pp.description: Time constant of sub-transient d-axis voltage Units: s.

Tq0_pp.description: Time constant of sub-transient q-axis voltage Units: s.

Xd_p.description: Transient reactance after EMF in d-axis

Xd_pp.description: Sub-Transient reactance after EMF in d-axis. Note: Xd_pp = Xq_pp

Se.description: Saturation factor at 1 and 1.2 pu flux: Se(eqp) = B(eqp-A)^2

title: SalientPoleMachine
